justification: The only shared content is the human head: A shows several small profile heads with patterned hair and beards within a procession of figures leading horned rams past a tree, framed by rosette bands, whereas B is a single large frontal head carved in the round with roughly hollowed eyes and no accompanying figures, animals or ornament. The narrative multi-figure register with animals and floral borders in A has no counterpart in B, and the manner of depiction (fine linear low relief versus blocky massed volumes) differs entirely.
